ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "UP", database: if ((payload[0].ok default 0) == 1) "UP" else "DOWN" }

db:select.doc:name: Select bookmark
db:select.db:sql: SELECT report_type, entity_code, DATE_FORMAT(last_reported_upto, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS last_reported_upto, last_successful_run, last_sequence_number, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS updated_at FROM compliance_report_control WHERE report_type = :reportType AND entity_code = :entityCode

raise-error.doc:name: Not found
raise-error.description: #[output application/java --- 'No control row for ' ++ vars.reportKey.reportType ++ '/' ++ vars.reportKey.entityCode]

db:select.doc:name: Select flag page
db:select.db:sql: SELECT f.flag_seq, t.transaction_id, DATE_FORMAT(t.transaction_datetime, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS transaction_datetime, t.account_number, t.customer_id, COALESCE(c.customer_name, :missingCustomerName) AS customer_name, COALESCE(c.customer_type, :missingCustomerType) AS customer_type, CASE WHEN c.customer_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS customer_missing, t.transaction_type, t.channel, t.currency, t.amount, t.counterparty_name, t.counterparty_country, f.flag_code, f.flag_reason, DATE_FORMAT(f.flagged_at, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS flagged_at, f.reviewed_by, f.review_status FROM transaction_flags f JOIN transactions t ON t.transaction_id = f.transaction_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id WHERE f.flagged_at >= :periodStart AND f.flagged_at < :periodEnd AND ( (:mode = 'PENDING' AND f.report_status = 'PENDING_REPORT') OR (:mode = 'RUN' AND f.reported_run_id = :runId) OR (:mode = 'ALL') ) AND (f.flagged_at, t.transaction_id, f.flag_code) > (:afterFlaggedAt, :afterTransactionId, :afterFlagCode) ORDER BY f.flagged_at, t.transaction_id, f.flag_code LIMIT :fetchLimit

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var q = attributes.queryParams --- { periodStart: q.periodStart, periodEnd: q.periodEnd, mode: q.mode default "PENDING", runId: q.runId default "" }

db:select.doc:name: Aggregate totals
db:select.db:sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS record_count, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS total_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.customer_id) AS customer_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.report_status = 'PENDING_REPORT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_count FROM transaction_flags f JOIN transactions t ON t.transaction_id = f.transaction_id WHERE f.flagged_at >= :periodStart AND f.flagged_at < :periodEnd AND ( (:mode = 'PENDING' AND f.report_status = 'PENDING_REPORT') OR (:mode = 'RUN' AND f.reported_run_id = :runId) OR (:mode = 'ALL') )

db:select.doc:name: Breakdown by flag code
db:select.db:sql: SELECT f.flag_code, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(t.amount) AS amount FROM transaction_flags f JOIN transactions t ON t.transaction_id = f.transaction_id WHERE f.flagged_at >= :periodStart AND f.flagged_at < :periodEnd AND ( (:mode = 'PENDING' AND f.report_status = 'PENDING_REPORT') OR (:mode = 'RUN' AND f.reported_run_id = :runId) OR (:mode = 'ALL') ) GROUP BY f.flag_code ORDER BY f.flag_code

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var t = vars.totals[0] --- { recordCount: t.record_count as Number, totalAmount: t.total_amount as Number, customerCount: t.customer_count as Number, pendingCount: t.pending_count as Number, byFlag: vars.byFlag map { flagCode: $.flag_code, count: $.cnt as Number, amount: $.amount as Number } }

db:select.doc:name: Pending flags before bookmark
db:select.db:sql: SELECT f.flag_seq, f.transaction_id, f.flag_code, DATE_FORMAT(f.flagged_at, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS flagged_at, t.amount FROM transaction_flags f JOIN transactions t ON t.transaction_id = f.transaction_id JOIN compliance_report_control c ON c.report_type = :reportType AND c.entity_code = :entityCode WHERE f.report_status = 'PENDING_REPORT' AND f.flagged_at < c.last_reported_upto ORDER BY f.flagged_at, f.transaction_id, f.flag_code

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload map { flagSeq: $.flag_seq as Number, transactionId: $.transaction_id, flagCode: $.flag_code, flaggedAt: $.flagged_at, amount: $.amount as Number }
